Maya (docs): quick heads-up — i'm opening a docs PR to add a small migration playbook for quantization profile changes in the Optimize toolkit. PR coming in a few mins. :wave:
Jordan (eng-ml): nice, can you include a short table of recommended batch sizes per model family? even rough guidance (gpt-small / gpt-medium / gpt-large) will help customers pick defaults.
Maya (docs): yes — i'll add a section. also going to include a minimal SDK snippet for batching + prefix caching that we can copy into the SDK examples page.
Priya (devex): pls make the snippet show both sync and async usage. users often ask why their streaming stops when they enable batching.
Sam (eng-runtime): add a note about KV-cache invalidation when you change the quant profile mid-rollout — we saw a user hit it last month. maybe a one-liner: "restart worker or invalidate cache for rolling update".
Jordan (eng-ml): also: mention quantization tradeoffs for per-token latency vs. throughput. 4-bit -> better throughput but sometimes worse stability on logits for rare tokens. a short sentence is enough.
Maya (docs): putting checklist here so reviewers know what to look for:
- include code snippet for SDK (sync + async)
- add batch size recommendations table
- explain cache/KV caveat with rollout ops
- link to profiling guide and quant conversion script
- add a small example CLI command for migration

Maya (docs): sample SDK snippet i'll include (feedback welcome):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
# set batching and prefix cache hints
resp = client.generate(
    model="gpt-medium-quant8",
    prompt="Summarize the following...",
    batch_hint=8,  # target batch size for sustained throughput
    cache_prefix=True,
    max_tokens=150,
)
print(resp.text)
```

Priya (devex): looks good — for async add an example using `async with client.stream()` and show how to flush the prefix cache when switching profiles.
Sam (eng-runtime): for the CLI migration snippet, suggest this pattern:

```bash
# export new quant profile and restart small subset
redwoodctl profiles apply --model gpt-medium --profile quant8-v2 --namespace prod-canary
# wait for health checks, then promote
redwoodctl rollout promote --namespace prod-canary --to prod
```

Jordan (eng-ml): small nit: in the table use "approx tokens/sec" not exact numbers — they vary a lot by sequence length.
Maya (docs): noted. I'll add a short section called "Quick migration steps" with the CLI + rollout checklist and the recommendation to test on a canary pool.
Maya (docs): PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (draft). Assigning @Jordan and @Priya for review.
docs-bot: maya pushed 3 commits to branch docs/quant-migration-playbook (view)

Jordan (eng-ml): i'll check the batch table and the accuracy tradeoff sentence tomorrow morning.
Sam (eng-runtime): i'll add a short troubleshooting blurb about "stale KV cache after quant swap" and a pointer to the internal runbook.
Maya (docs): awesome — thanks team. i'll iterate and move PR out of draft once the code examples are polished. :pray:
